approvers: Main contractor or developer who sets protection in the subcontract package; my MD
reason: Protection is specified in the subcontract package and the main contractor decides who pays, so I can't choose this myself. My real worry is the coating marking coated glass or frames when it comes off, and nobody has told me who pays for that.
objection: If it marks the frame or the coated glass when it peels off, who pays? Glass and coating manufacturers exclude this, and a test panel doesn't cover 18 months on site in the Maltese sun.
instead: Keep using the current protective film or coating where the package asks for it, or simply careful site management and cleaning at handover.
would_change_my_mind: Written confirmation from the main glass and coating manufacturers that it is compatible with their warranty, plus ACHV carrying the damage liability in writing with insurance, and a local reference on a similar job.
